column3: MT 17:17. “a rod for each” renders “a rod, a rod”; the word (matteh) also means “tribe.”
MT 17:20. “I shall lessen” renders “I shall make subside.”
MT 17:21. “a rod apiece” renders the repeated “a rod for one leader, a rod for one leader.”
MT 17:25. “the rebels” renders “the sons of rebellion.”
MT 17:28. “Are we to perish completely?” renders “Will we finish dying?”
